name: Ollie Cantos
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 4th District

items.text: Ollie Cantos is the Mayor Pro Tem of West Covina, representing District 4 since 2022. He is a civil rights attorney who worked at the U.S. Department of Justice and as Associate Director of Domestic Policy at the White House. In 2023, he chaired the board of RespectAbility, a disability advocacy nonprofit.

sentences.text: Ollie Cantos is the Mayor Pro Tem of West Covina, representing District 4 since 2022.
He is a civil rights attorney who worked at the U.S. Department of Justice and as Associate Director of Domestic Policy at the White House.
In 2023, he chaired the board of RespectAbility, a disability advocacy nonprofit.

items.text: In 2026, he authored a resolution opposing data centers and battery storage over environmental and fire risks. The resolution passed unanimously. He urged the council to stop escalating disagreements. He abstained on a motion to censure Councilmember Gutierrez. He voted to send an investigative report to the district attorney. His 2026 questionnaire supports zero-based budgeting and a pension trust. He also prioritizes infrastructure repairs.
